issue: #18 issue-body item 3 (S-DUP-2, S-ID-1) and item 5 (what the UI actually exposes)
writtenBefore: any line of the implementation, and before the first run
theGap: The CFO Proof report enumerates GOVERNED ROOTS. So it structurally cannot see an obligation that never became a case: one the detector refused, one still awaiting review, one rejected at review, or an aggregate nobody promoted. A reader seeing 'detected $1,400.00 / open $1,400.00' would reasonably take that for the book. The report's own completeness is therefore overstated by omission, which is the same family as 'an empty report is the same shape whether the book is clean or was never read'.

measuredFindings.claim: reconciliationObserver computes refusedExposure and it reaches NO record, API or screen
measuredFindings.evidence: AgentHandler.run returns Promise<readonly CandidateSignal[]>, and the observer's run() returns signalsForPlan(plan, ...) — the plan carrying refusedExposure is discarded at the handler boundary. 16 occurrences of refusedExposure repository-wide: 3 in the observer, the rest in its own two test files. Zero in src/modules, src/components, server/app.ts or server/http.
measuredFindings.correctionOfMyOwnEarlierClaim: I recorded 'the reporting is fixed' for S-ID-1 and marked that work complete. What shipped was the plan FIELD and its tests, with no consumer — exactly the half the obligation_ref revert rule forbids: no field is declared until the production code that reads it ships in the same slice.

measuredFindings.claim: making refused exposure visible requires either an AgentHandler contract change or input retention for this detector, so it is NOT doable inside this slice
measuredFindings.whyNotDoneHere: widening run()'s return type touches every handler and the runtime's event writer; that is a design decision with an owner, proposed rather than taken.
